bibliographic.title: MedHallu: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Detecting Medical Hallucinations in Large Language Models

relevance_to_mlgg: Provides 10k expert-annotated medical QA pairs for hallucination detection. Benchmark methodology applicable to validating extract_paper_metadata.py outputs. Key finding: domain-specific knowledge improves detection by up to 38%.
key_findings: GPT-4o and Llama-3.1 struggle with binary hallucination detection
Domain-specific knowledge improved performance by up to 38%
actionable_for_mlgg: Adapt PubMedQA benchmark approach to create ground-truth for metadata extraction validation
Use domain-knowledge augmentation in system prompt to reduce extraction hallucination
Binary detection framework applicable to verifying individual extracted fields
